comparison: Subagent missed-result maintenance before and after direct idle publication

workload.execution: Old then new, each with a fresh isolated database, repeated three times
workload.result_oracle: 140 original notifications with unchanged result text in each run

measurement.maintenance_wall: Time awaiting maintain(); remaining foreground requests are awaited afterward
measurement.engine_statements: SQLAlchemy before_cursor_execute events, including reads and BEGIN; subtract 50 foreground BEGIN and 50 foreground INSERT statements
measurement.owner_interval: FIFO admission granted through connection checkout, BEGIN, transaction, commit and physical/session cleanup before owner release
measurement.foreground_entry_wait: Requesting immediate_session() through entry after BEGIN, including FIFO, connection checkout and BEGIN
measurement.percentile: Sorted samples at floor((n - 1) * 0.95); owner samples are 420 old and 9 new, foreground samples are 50 per run
measurement.diagnostic_elapsed_clock: perf_counter in the isolated probe; only Database and diagnostic elapsed-time clocks were replaced
measurement.clock_limit: Native Python 3.12 Windows monotonic diagnostics showed roughly 15.6 ms steps. High-resolution phase timing does not remove event-loop timer coalescing; 5 ms is the scheduled arrival spacing, not a guaranteed observed interval.
measurement.raw_intervals: Retained in local Reports; excluded from this public summary

interpretation.maintenance: Maintenance wall time and total writer ownership fell in all three pairs; the final publisher performs three business SQL operations per page.
interpretation.foreground: Foreground p95 increased by 9.357, 4.492 and 17.061 ms. This fixed burst workload remains a latency regression and is not an across-the-board performance win.
interpretation.phase_reading: Most foreground entry wait was FIFO admission. Connection-checkout p95 stayed below 0.22 ms; BEGIN p95 was 0.56-1.56 ms.
interpretation.scope: Synthetic local maintenance and foreground inserts, not production latency or a full Agent/model/platform benchmark.
